sub.id: Lokasi, kontak, dan panduan pertanyaan sebelum kunjungan.
sub.en: Location, contact details, and questions to ask before visiting.

ringkas.en: Confirm whether dental cleaning is offered.
Ask about treatment options after an assessment.
Ask how to schedule a follow-up visit.

penjelasan.id: Siapkan pertanyaan tentang dokter, jadwal, dan layanan sebelum berkunjung.
penjelasan.en: Prepare questions about practitioners, hours, and services before visiting.

fitur_khas.alasan_dipilih: Informasi jadwal dan dokter belum terverifikasi dalam direktori publik.

a.id: Direktori mencantumkan kawasan Kalicacing, Sidomukti, Salatiga. Konfirmasi alamat lengkap sebelum berangkat.
a.en: Directories list Kalicacing, Sidomukti, Salatiga. Confirm the full address before travelling.

a.id: Jadwal resmi belum ditemukan pada sumber yang diperiksa. Silakan tanyakan sebelum berkunjung.
a.en: Official hours were not found in the sources checked. Please ask before visiting.

a.id: Biaya belum ditemukan di sumber publik yang diperiksa. Tanyakan rincian langsung kepada praktik.
a.en: Fees were not found in the sources checked. Please ask the practice.

a.id: Jadwal dan identitas dokter belum dapat diverifikasi. Tanyakan kepada pengelola.
a.en: Dentist names and schedules could not be verified. Please ask the practice.

a.id: Ketersediaan layanan anak belum terverifikasi. Silakan konfirmasi sebelum membuat janji.
a.en: Children's services have not been verified. Please confirm before booking.
